1.t: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;

2.t: Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true).

3.t: Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones?

4.t: Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers!

5.t: But man would fain deny what is before him.

6.t: He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection?

9.t: And sun and moon are united,

10.t: On that day man will cry: Whither to flee!

12.t: Unto thy Lord is the recourse that day.

13.t: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind.

14.t: Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself,

16.t: Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it.

17.t: Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof.

18.t: And when We read it, follow thou the reading;

19.t: Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof.

20.t: Nay, but ye do love the fleeting Now

22.t: That day will faces be resplendent,

24.t: And that day will other faces be despondent,

25.t: Thou wilt know that some great disaster is about to fall on them.

26.t: Nay, but when the life cometh up to the throat

27.t: And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now)?

28.t: And he knoweth that it is the parting;

29.t: And agony is heaped on agony;

30.t: Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving.

31.t: For he neither trusted, nor prayed.

33.t: Then went he to his folk with glee.

35.t: Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom).

36.t: Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless?

37.t: Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth?

38.t: Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned

39.t: And made of him a pair, the male and female.

40.t: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life?
